goal: Use a small selected batch of animation references to fill distinct missing Movement Lego evidence while keeping additional useful references organized without forcing them into the current 17-card hunt.
rules: Prefer a new missing Lego block over a duplicate unless the duplicate adds a materially different mechanic.
Each source is classified KEEP_STUDY, MAYBE, or SKIP.
Raw FBX binaries are not committed while redistribution/license status is unverified.
A source can support multiple Lego blocks, but one primary block is assigned for hunt accounting.
Animation evidence supplies 3D mechanics; paired MoveNet FRONT + SIDE evidence will be collected separately.
CANDIDATE means useful evidence exists; it does not mean validated or runtime-ready.
High-value mechanics outside the current 17-card registry are logged as supplemental future primitives rather than misclassified.
